sorry_inventory.statement: theorem primeC'_exists_maximal (x₀ A₀ h0 𝒮 hfair hRedundant hprimeC) : ∃ σ, Maximal (· ∈ primeC G₀ x₀ A₀) (𝒮.H σ) ∧ FLO 𝒮 σ -- one sorry remaining: the 'no strict primeC-extension exists' half of the Maximal conjunct, at σ0 := Ordinal.lsub (choose ∘ hfair)
sorry_inventory.assumption: Assumes hfair's one-shot-per-task firing, past a bound σ0 strictly after every task's guaranteed firing, is sufficient for 𝒮.H σ0 to be closed under every primeC-preserving one-step extension (i.e. Maximal).
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: NEWLY IDENTIFIED this dispatch (distinct from, and deeper than, the redundantEdge finding): stepExt's .formula/.diaWitness branches are no-ops when their precondition fails (label not yet present / witness already present); a task's precondition can become newly satisfiable only AFTER its one hfair-guaranteed firing (e.g. .formula φ fires while φ.lbl is not yet in the domain, with φ.lbl entering only later via an unrelated .diaWitness task). hfair gives no re-attempt guarantee, so σ0's 𝒮.H σ0 need not be primeC-maximal. FLO 𝒮 σ0 (via flo_holds_everywhere) and 𝒮.H σ0 ∈ primeC (via hprimeC σ0) are BOTH sorry-free; only this one conjunct-half is open.
sorry_inventory.follow_up_task: Plan v5 Phase 4 continuation (or fold into Phase 5): (1) strengthen hfair to a cofinal, precondition-aware fairness hypothesis (∀ σ' t, <precondition of t available at σ'> → ∃ σ ≥ σ', 𝒮.task σ = t); (2) prove a cardinality/ordinal-stabilization lemma (Label Atom/Context substructure bounded cardinality in Type u; Stage = Ordinal.{u} unboundedly large past that bound) showing a cofinally-fair, primeC-preserving, monotone-growing schedule stabilizes at a maximal stage. See summaries/14_flo-maximal-phase4-summary.md Decisions/Follow-ups for the full gap analysis.

sorry_inventory.statement: theorem flo_oldlabel_transport {𝒮 : FloSeq 𝒯 Atom G₀} {σ : Stage} (hflo : FLO 𝒮 σ) ... : ∀ y' ∈ (𝒮.H σ).G.X, x ≠ y' → (∀ ψ ∈ Γ, ψ.lbl ≠ y') → NIK 𝒯 ((𝒮.H σ).G.addEdge x y') Γ (y' ∶ A)
sorry_inventory.assumption: Assumes FLO-2's rank-indexed edge locality supports a well-founded (rank-indexed) induction transporting a NIK-derivation witnessed at one fresh label to ANY other label, including old ones already in the domain.
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: The mathematical crux (plan v5 Risk 'HIGH'). Phase 4 scope was assembling the maximal FLO context, not this transport lemma; this remains Phase 5's dedicated proof obligation. UNCHANGED by Phase 4 (FLO 𝒮 σ is now available sorry-free at any stage reached by a flo_holds_everywhere-satisfying schedule, which is what this theorem will consume).
